leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eleventh season of , Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eleventh season of , Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension, in and ( ).

==Volume releases==
Three Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension DVD box sets were released by VIZ Media and distributed through . in 2009, containing the whole season between them. There are three boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets.

===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-17===
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Box Set 1 was released on June 23, 2009. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBDBS01. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 2: Episodes 18-34===
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Box Set 2 was released on August 25, 2009. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBDBS02.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 3: Episodes 35-52===
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Box Set 3 was released on October 27, 2009. It contains two discs with 18 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBDBS03.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

Two episodes are mistitled on the back of the DVD cases: One Team, Two Team Red Team, Blue Team! is listed as Go Team Go! on disc five, and Jumping Rocket Ship! is listed as Jumping Rock Ship on disc six.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Diamond and Pearl: Battle Dimension Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on January 7, 2020 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 52 episodes across them combined. In line with other releases, it includes DP071 and DP072 out of US broadcast order, following DP082 instead of DP081. Its catalogue number is 3000081796. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.
